messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — there's a large rolling suitcase by the lobby couch with a generic 'visitor' luggage tag but no badge. Anyone know who's expecting a guest?
Frontdesk Bot: Visitor check-in: "Elena Torres" at 10:05. Badge status: not printed. Front desk asked to confirm ID. :clipboard:
Jamal Ortiz: Oh, I let a delivery person leave it earlier when I was carrying coffee. Sorry — I walked past and thought it was a courier drop.
Priya Nair: No worries. Can front desk hold it at reception? Also we have the tea cart scheduled for the 11:30 standup — could that block the couch area?
Frontdesk Bot: Received. Holding luggage at Desk A. Tea cart booking for 11:30 is confirmed by Office Calendar.
Zoe Li: Also small thing — one of the visitor lanyards popped off the badge reel and stuck to a cookie tin 😂 can someone check the kitchenette? Could be why no badge was on the suitcase.
Maya Chen: Ack that explains it. @Frontdesk Bot can you photo the luggage tag and DM the host? If it's a mis-drop we can move it to storage.
Frontdesk Bot: Photo posted to #ops-uploads: https://files.redwood.example/abc123 — Host on file: 'Redwood Events' (ext 324). Requesting host confirmation.
Jamal Ortiz: If host confirms, please move to package locker 2. If not, I'll bring it to lost-and-found.
Priya Nair: Quick checklist for front desk so we have consistent flow:
```
1) Confirm host via visitor system
2) Ask for ID if no badge
3) Print badge + attach lanyard
4) Store luggage in locker 2 if host not present
5) Log item in lost-and-found spreadsheet
```
Zoe Li: Propose a tiny sticky label on luggage tags that says 'check with front desk' — reduces mystery.
Maya Chen: Agree. Also, tea cart volunteers: @Jamal @Priya you're on for snacks — can you confirm gluten-free options?
Jamal Ortiz: Will do, bringing GF cookies and almond milk.
Priya Nair: I'll bring tea and a small sign 'Mind the luggage' :stuck_out_tongue: 
Frontdesk Bot: Host 'Redwood Events' confirmed — guest is here, badge was misplaced. Luggage moved to locker 2, badge reprinted and attached. Logged by Maya at 10:08.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. Filing as resolved. :white_check_mark:
Zoe Li: +kudos to front desk for the speedy recover :clap:
